VARA’S SKILLS

Your equipped companion supports you automatically and reserves one command token for your orders. Strong support has its own cooldown; buffs expire and cannot stack by swapping companions. Hold R to choose a command and target, then release. C opens this panel. “Use now” resumes the game and performs the real action.

A native climb-and-dive carries a tailwind to you: +12% movement speed for 4 seconds. Only 4 damage (6 if marked); consumes the mark. 10-second support cooldown.

Marks an engaged threat, then dives to refresh your tailwind when a token can be spared.
